meta.servicesDescription: Kwandikisha, imisoro, ubutaka, uruhushya rwo gutwara, serivisi za polisi n'ibyemezo i Kigali. Inzira ni ikigo cyigenga. Amafaranga y'urwego n'aya Inzira bigaragara ukwabyo.

footer.blurb: Inyandiko za leta mu Rwanda, zirasuzumwa, zikoherezwa kandi zigakurikiranwa ku bwawe.
footer.disclaimer: Inzira ni sosiyete yigenga itanga ubufasha bw'umwuga. Ntabwo turi Irembo, RRA, RDB, RURA, ubuyobozi bw'ubutaka cyangwa urundi rwego urwo ari rwo rwose rwa leta, kandi ntidutanga inama z'amategeko. Amafaranga y'urwego n'imisoro bishyirwaho kandi bigakusanywa n'urwego rubifitiye ububasha; amafaranga ya Inzira yo gufasha ari ukwayo kandi agaragazwa ku murongo wayo wihariye buri gihe.

about.h1: Inyandiko za leta, tuzikugurira i Kigali
about.lead: Kompanyi yigenga i Kigali. Dutanga ibyangombwa bya leta tukakoherereza igisubizo.
about.does: Ibyemezo, impushya, imisoro, ubutaka, gutwara abantu n'ubucuruzi, ku bantu no ku makompanyi mu Rwanda.
about.not: Si Irembo, RRA, RDB, RURA, polisi cyangwa ibiro bya leta. Urwego nirwo rufata icyemezo.
about.name: Hari abandi mu Rwanda bakoresha izina Inzira. Uru rubuga ni urwa Inzira Ltd, i Kigali gusa.

legal.privacyLead: Ibyo Inzira ibika kuri wowe, n'igihe ibibikira.
legal.who: {legal} ni ikigo cyigenga i {city}. Ntabwo turi urwego rwa leta, kandi ntabwo turi Irembo. Wandikire {email} cyangwa uhamagare {phone}.
legal.collect: Dusaba izina ryawe na imeri kugira ngo dutangire ubusabe. Nomero ya telefoni si itegeko, ikoreshwa mu guhamagara cyangwa kuri WhatsApp. Dusaba indangamuntu gusa iyo serivisi iyikeneye, kandi tubibwira mbere yo kuyandika. Wongeyeho inyandiko iyo serivisi isaba. Tubika nomero y'ubwishyu bw'amafaranga waduhaye.
legal.not: Ntidushakisha umwirondoro wawe mu gitabo cya leta. Ntidureba NIDA, Irembo cyangwa RRA. Umubare w'imibare 16 si ukuri ko indangamuntu ibaho, cyangwa ko ari iyawe.
legal.keep: Inyandiko wohereje zisibwa nyuma y'iminsi {days} ubusabe bumaranye, cyangwa vuba iyo ubisabye. Ibyangombwa tuguha biguma muri konti yawe kugeza uyisiba. Amakuru y'ubwishyu aguma, kuko ari amafaranga yanditswe. Niyo usiba konti, ayo makuru aguma ariko nta zina, imeri cyangwa telefoni yawe.
legal.see: Umukozi ukurikirana ubusabe bwawe ni we ubibona. Twohereza urwego ibyo ubwo busabe bukeneye gusa. Ntidugurisha imyirondoro yawe.
legal.delete: Ushobora gusiba konti yawe iyo nta busabe bukiri gukorwa. Izina, imeri, telefoni n'inyandiko birasibwa. Ushobora kandi gusaba ko inyandiko z'ubusabe bwarangiye zisibwa mbere y'iminsi {days}.
legal.termsLead: Ibyo tugukorera, ibyo twishyurwa, n'icyo tutashobora gufata.
legal.do: Inzira itegura ubusabe, irohereza mu nzira yemewe, ikabukurikirana. Turi ikigo cyigenga. Ntabwo turi urwego, kandi ntidufata icyemezo.
legal.fees: Buri serivisi igaragaza amafaranga abiri mbere yo kwishyura. Amafaranga y'urwego ashyirwaho n'urwego. Akenshi uyarwo uwishyurira urwego, inyemezabwishyu ikaza mu izina ryawe. Amafaranga ya Inzira yishyura gusuzuma, gutegura, kohereza no gukurikirana. Twumvikana mbere yo gutangira. Iyo amafaranga y'urwego anyuze muri twe, nta kirenga kigirwaho.
legal.decide: Urwego ni rwo rwemera cyangwa rwanze ubusabe. Twohereza ubusabe buzuye kandi tukabukurikirana. Ntidushobora kwemera igisubizo.
legal.stop: Ushobora gusaba ko duhagarika mbere y'uko ubusabe bwoherezwa. Amafaranga ya Inzira asubizwa iyo umurimo utaratangira, kandi ibyo byandikwa ku busabe. Amafaranga y'urwego yamaze kwishyurwa akurikiza amategeko y'urwo rwego.
legal.docs: Ohereza inyandiko ufite uburenganzira bwo gutanga. Tuzikoresha ku bwo ubwo busabe gusa. Urupapuro rw'ibanga rugaragaza igihe tuzibikira.
legal.company: {legal} ihura n'abantu ku gihe mwumvikanyeho i {city}. Hamagara {phone} cyangwa wandikire {email}.

contact.waPrefill: Muraho Inzira, nkeneye ubufasha ku busabe bwanjye.

home.deletedBody: Imyirondoro yawe n'inyandiko zawe byasibwe. Amakuru y'ubwishyu yagumyeho ariko nta zina cyangwa nomero yawe birimo.
home.hero: Inyandiko za leta, zigukorerwa uri kuri telefoni yawe.
home.lead: Ibyemezo, impushya, imisoro, ubutaka n'ubucuruzi. Nta mirongo, nta ngendo.

home.feesLead: Amafaranga yacu kuri buri serivisi aragenwe kandi twumvikanaho mbere y'uko dutangira.
home.feesNote: Amafaranga y'urwego ashyirwaho n'urwego rubifitiye ububasha kandi agaragazwa kuri buri serivisi mbere yo kwishyura. Akenshi uyishyurira urwego ubwarwo mu buryo butaziguye, inyemezabwishyu ikaza mu izina ryawe. Nta kirenga kigirwaho iyo anyuze muri Inzira.
home.notListed: Serivisi nkeneye ntabwo iri ku rutonde
home.howLead: Intambwe enye zoroshye, kandi iya mbere gusa niyo igusaba kugira icyo ukora. Umukozi umwe agufasha kuva ku ntangiriro kugeza ku musozo.
home.s1d: Hitamo serivisi, cyangwa usobanure ibyo ukeneye mu Kinyarwanda, Icyongereza cyangwa Igifaransa. Kubaza kuri WhatsApp cyangwa kuri telefoni ni ubuntu.
home.s2d: Tukumenyesha neza inyandiko ibura mbere y'uko ubusabe bwoherezwa. Aha ni ho haturuka kenshi kudasubizwa neza.
home.s3d: Bikorerwa ku rubuga rw'urwego rubifitiye ububasha. Uhabwa nomero y'ubusabe, kandi twihutisha ubusabe bwatinze.
home.s4d: Icyangombwa n'inyemezabwishyu byoherezwa muri konti yawe no kuri WhatsApp.
home.a1: {legal}, kompanyi yigenga i {city}. Tugukorera ibyangombwa bya leta.
home.q2: Muri abakozi ba leta cyangwa ba Irembo?
home.a2: Oya. Turi abikorera, tubitanga mu nzira zemewe mu izina ryawe.
home.a3: Amwe ajya ku rwego uko ari. Andi ni ayacu. Ubanza kubona yombi.
home.q4: Mushobora kwizeza 100% ko ubusabe bwanjye bwemerwa?
home.a4: Ntawabishobora. Tubitanga byuzuye kandi neza, tukabikurikirana.
home.q5: Bigenze bite se niba serivisi nkeneye itari ku rutonde?
home.a5: Tubwire icyo ukeneye. Tubanza kumvikana uko n'igiciro.
home.closeTitle: Ntubizi neza? Baza kuri WhatsApp. Ni ubuntu.
home.closeLead: Tukubwira intambwe n'igiciro mbere y'uko wiyemeza.
home.twoTitle: Amafaranga abiri, buri gihe agaragazwa ukwayo
home.twoLead: Ubona ayo mafaranga yombi kuri buri serivisi mbere yo kwishyura, kandi buri rimwe uraryemeza.
home.twoOfficialD: Ashyirwaho kandi agakusanywa n'urwego. Akenshi uyishyurira urwego ubwarwo, inyemezabwishyu ikaza mu izina ryawe. Nta kirenga kigirwaho iyo anyuze muri Inzira.
home.twoOursD: Aragenwe kandi twumvikanaho mbere y'uko dutangira. Yishyura gusuzuma, gutegura, kohereza no gukurikirana.
home.feeLine: Amafaranga y'urwego n'ayacu kuri buri serivisi. Nta kongeraho.
home.filedShort: Inzira ni kompanyi yigenga, si ibi biro.

email.codeIntro: Koresha iyi kode kugira ngo winjire muri Inzira. Irarangira mu minota 10.
